items.title: Bitcoin rebounds past $80,000 as markets shrug off midterms and Binance hack
items.summary: Bitcoin rose 3.5% to $80,500 and ether jumped 6% after Democrats won Congress, while Bitwise says the Binance hack had limited market impact.

items.title: US Bank Regulator Issues First AI Framework as Banks Battle Rogue Agents
items.summary: The OCC's first examiner guide weighs autonomy and financial harm, and directly addresses outside AI agents—the same risk that recently prompted major banks to restrict customer-account access.

items.title: Trump-linked tokens lead crypto losses after Democrats sweep in the US midterms
items.summary: The official Trump and World Liberty Financial tokens were the two biggest losers among the top 100 cryptocurrencies on Wednesday even as Bitcoin and Ether rallied.

items.title: French Hill’s race still too close to call as House flips, changing the direction of crypto legislation
items.summary: As of Wednesday afternoon, House Financial Services Committee Chair French Hill's race for reelection is too close to call.

items.title: Riot shares surge on $28B AI lease as Hut 8 sinks on revenue miss
items.summary: Bitcoin miner Riot sold BTC to finance its AI expansion, while Hut 8 reported falling revenue and rising costs before its major data center leases generate income.

items.title: US Voters Back AI Data Center Restrictions in At Least 29 Communities
items.summary: Voters across the United States backed measures to curb data centers, raising new obstacles for the infrastructure powering AI as electricity bills, water supplies, and public oversight dominate the debate.

items.title: Matt Corallo Flags Critical Linux Kernel Flaw; Lightning Labs Ships LND Mitigation
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Matt Corallo Flags Critical Linux Kernel Flaw; Lightning Labs Ships LND Mitigation  
 Bitcoin Core and Lightning developer Matt Corallo highlighted CVE-2026-98432 on October 30, a use-after-free in the Linux kernel IPv4 TCP handshake code scored CVSS 9.8. Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team demonstrated a remote root exploit against systems with a Multipath TCP listener. 
 This post  Matt Corallo Flags Critical Linux Kernel Flaw; Lightning Labs Ships LND Mitigation  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Juan Galt .

items.title: Strategy’s STRC Hits $100 Par for First Time Since May After Over $2 Billion in Buybacks
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Strategy’s STRC Hits $100 Par for First Time Since May After Over $2 Billion in Buybacks  
 Strategy’s STRC preferred hit $100 par on Wednesday for the first time since May, after billions in buybacks, a 12% dividend rate and a switch to daily payouts. 
 This post  Strategy’s STRC Hits $100 Par for First Time Since May After Over $2 Billion in Buybacks  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Canton Coin Gets SEC Nod as Wall Street Tokenization Heats Up
items.summary: SEC staff said they view Canton Coin as a digital commodity and won’t recommend enforcement over how it’s minted, a week after DTCC launched a tokenization service that runs partly on the Canton Network.

items.title: Jack Dorsey’s Block (XYZ) Sets Aside $764 Million for DOJ Settlement as Bitcoin Profit Halves
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Jack Dorsey’s Block (XYZ) Sets Aside $764 Million for DOJ Settlement as Bitcoin Profit Halves  
 Block agreed in principle to a $764 million deferred-prosecution deal over anti-money-laundering failures at Cash App, a sum that exceeds its $566 million Q3 profit, while bitcoin gross profit fell 50% after the company cut trading fees. 
 This post  Jack Dorsey’s Block (XYZ) Sets Aside $764 Million for DOJ Settlement as Bitcoin Profit Halves  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Circle’s ARC token sale lifts earnings as lower yields weigh on USDC income
items.summary: Circle is looking to payments fees and future staking rewards to diversify revenue as its core stablecoin business faces pressure from lower yields and growing competition.

items.title: Librería de Satoshi Rebrands to ISMOS, Launches Global Platform to Train One Million Bitcoin Developers
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Librería de Satoshi Rebrands to ISMOS, Launches Global Platform to Train One Million Bitcoin Developers  
 Dulce Villarreal’s ISMOS rebrands from Latin America’s Librería de Satoshi and launches a multilingual open-source platform to train one million Bitcoin and Freedom Tech developers worldwide, backed by Btrust and the Human Rights Foundation. 
 This post  Librería de Satoshi Rebrands to ISMOS, Launches Global Platform to Train One Million Bitcoin Developers  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Juan Galt .

items.title: What Is x402? How AI Agents Pay With Crypto
items.summary: Coinbase's x402 protocol puts the web's long-unused 402 code to work so AI agents and apps can pay for APIs and data in stablecoins like USDC.

items.title: Democrats to Target Trump’s Crypto Ventures After Taking Congress
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Democrats to Target Trump’s Crypto Ventures After Taking Congress  
 Democrats are reportedly preparing subpoenas targeting President Trump's World Liberty Financial ties, its $500 million Emirati stake and the Changpeng Zhao pardon. 
 This post  Democrats to Target Trump’s Crypto Ventures After Taking Congress  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Micah Zimmerman .

items.summary: Microsoft and Alphabet surged while Nvidia and Tesla fell, highlighting a divided market as investors reassess Washington's approach to AI and Big Tech.

items.summary: Coinbase says 99% of customer assets are in cold storage and it wasn't affected by the $6.3 billion Binance hack.

items.summary: Bitcoin bounced back after Democrats won control of Congress, but a stalled market structure bill and heavy industry campaign spending reveal crypto’s exposure to shifting US political power.

items.title: Wall Street’s Plumbing Goes Onchain as Morgan Stanley Tokenizes Securities
items.summary: Morgan Stanley says it has converted U.S. equities and Treasuries into tokenized form through the newly launched DTCC Tokenization Service, which 20 Wall Street firms have signed up to use.

items.title: Schroders launches tokenized emerging markets debt fund on Solana with Centrifuge
items.summary: The $1 trillion-plus asset manager brings its emerging markets bond strategy to Solana, expanding the range of onchain actively managed funds.

items.title: U.S. Democratic sweep could be the final nail in the ‘Clarity Act’s coffin’
items.summary: Industry experts warn the Clarity Act is likely dead in its current form as incoming Democratic majorities eye tighter scrutiny of crypto markets and tokenized stocks.

items.title: Wall Street rethinks AI data center boom as Texas election raises new risks
items.summary: Bitcoin miners pivoting to AI face new uncertainty over power access and construction permits, while companies with approved projects could benefit from tighter supply.

items.title: TD Cowen: Democratic Sweep Makes a Crypto-Backed CLARITY Act ‘Impossible’
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 TD Cowen: Democratic Sweep Makes a Crypto-Backed CLARITY Act ‘Impossible’  
 The Democratic sweep and Sherrod Brown’s return may kill the CLARITY Act for two years and may make any industry-backed version impossible as Democrats investigate Trump’s crypto ties, TD Cowen analysts write. 
 This post  TD Cowen: Democratic Sweep Makes a Crypto-Backed CLARITY Act ‘Impossible’  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Confirms Cyberattack After ZachXBT Ties It to $133M Crypto Theft
items.summary: The French bank said the attack allowed "fraudulent operations" but did not mention crypto, and is still assessing the amounts.

items.summary: Bitcoin climbed toward $80,500 as risk assets rallied on Democrats’ midterm election gains and oil prices fell.
